description.en:
Adds one character to the party with the recruitment presentation. The jingle J_08 plays, the system message "sysmes-add_party" is shown with the character's name filled in (CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_CHARA), then the character is added with AddParty, and the function waits until the jingle has finished.
The BGM is left playing: no fade and no extra wait.
It is a preset of AddParty_MessageEx(1, [_paramID], [_ptLock], [_avatarEnable], [_avatarLock], [_lv], -1, -1, "J_08", 0, "sysmes-add_party").
Parameter ID of the character to add, e.g. "para_cp0015".
Passed to CMND_SET_PT_LOCK_FLAG for the new member. Every shipped call passes true.
Passed to CMND_SET_AVATAR_ENABLE (whether the member's Fighting Spirit is enabled). Most shipped calls pass false; a few later events pass true for para_cp0009 and para_cp0010.
Passed to CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG for the new member.
Level to give the member with CMND_SET_LV. Only used when greater than 0.

examples.case: Adding a member without touching the BGM (real usage, from ev42012500.nut)
Same, with a level (real usage, from ev42082500.nut)
examples.code:
// para_cp0016 joins at level 25; the BGM keeps playing
AddParty_Message_NoFadeBGM("para_cp0016", true, false, false, 25);
